title: 5-DOF Haptic Exoskeleton for Teleoperation
description: Constructed a 5-DOF wearable exoskeleton for real-time haptic teleoperation, providing tactile feedback of remote robot forces. Enhanced operator control accuracy by 40% and achieved <100 ms force-feedback latency. Integrated ROS, motor control, and VR hardware in NVIDIA Isaac Sim for a complete sim-to-real workflow.

title: 3D LiDAR-Based SLAM & Autonomous Navigation
description: Revamped autonomous navigation using ROS2 and Isaac Sim. Generated high-fidelity 3D point cloud maps with Cartographer and 3D LiDAR, converting them to 2D costmaps. Integrated with Nav2 for accurate localization and collision avoidance in simulation.

title: AI Manipulator with NVIDIA Groot
description: Achieved real-time multi-modal control (gesture, audio, perception) on an Open Manipulator X by fine-tuning NVIDIA’s Groot N1.5 foundation model with synthetic data from Isaac Sim. Integrated a ROS2 pipeline with a custom AI interface on Jetson Nano for inference and motion planning.

title: Interactive Social Robots for Autism Therapy
description: Designed and programmed two mobile robots using ROS2 and Raspberry Pi to teach balance, path following, and language to children with autism. Improved learning rates by 50% through emotion-aware cues and emoji expressions. Achieved ~95% tracking accuracy with PID control.

title: Edge AI Product for Visually Impaired
description: Deployed real-time object detection models (YOLOv5) on Raspberry Pi/Jetson for public transport and currency recognition, achieving 95% accuracy on a 50,000+ image dataset. Reduced inference latency by 30% through model compression and integrated an NLP speech interface.

title: Automated Irrigation System
description: Pioneered a Random Forest Regressor (86% test accuracy) for predictive automated irrigation. Optimized a smart sprinkler system, reducing water consumption by 65% and outperforming competing solutions by 15%.
